generations.name: Launch (400 V)
generations.notes: Launch MY2025 on SPA2: 111 kWh gross (~107 usable) pack, 400 V, DC up to 250 kW; Long Range Single (RWD) and Dual Motor. An 800 V update (Dual/Performance 106 kWh at up to 350 kW, rear-motor 92 kWh at 310 kW) launched in Europe in 2026, labelled MY26 or MY27; Polestar said U.S. availability would be announced later. When it reaches North America it should start a new generation, so last_year is left open. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/774327/2026-polestar-3-facelift-battery-charging-specs/ ; https://www.electrive.com/2025/10/01/polestar-3-to-adopt-800-volt-architecture/ ; https://www.cars.com/articles/new-battery-and-motor-enhance-2026-polestar-3-516707
